Reading the table:

- **Tier-2 admission** is the build-time qualification of the private-root switch. A boot still enables admission only in a development profile; fleet profiles (`policy-required`, `production-relay-image`) keep it closed unless the x86 browser profile is selected (`kernel/src/main.rs`, "Tier 2 admission" log line).
- **Lane rows** count `scripts/lanes.toml` rows; `default` rows run on the workspace default target, `riscv64gc-unknown-none-elf` (scripts/cargo-config-linux.toml). A `manual` row is not a verdict on whether the lane passes.
- **`MAX_HARTS`** is the value without optional features (`g1-cpu-accounting` lowers x86_64 to 2).

## Sources

| Column | Probe |
|---|---|
| Kernel arch module | `kernel/src/arch/mod.rs`: cfg on each `mod <arch>;` |
| 64-bit set | `kernel/src/posture.rs::wide` |
| Tier-2 admission | `kernel/src/loader/domain_admission.rs::switch_ordering_qualified` |
| Domain grants | `kernel/src/posture.rs::domain_grants` |
| Tier-3 hypervisor module | `kernel/src/arch/<arch>/hypervisor/` exists |
| `MAX_HARTS` | `kernel/src/sched/smp.rs::MAX_HARTS` |
| Kernel RAM alias | `hal::paging::phys_to_virt` in each arch's HAL paging file (returns `phys`: identity; adds an offset: HHDM) |
| Toolchain target | `rust-toolchain.toml` `targets` |
| Workflows | `.github/workflows/*.yml` files with a line naming the kernel target |
| Lane rows | `scripts/lanes.toml` `arch` and `tier` |
| Board descriptors | `boards/**/board.rs` `slug` and `architecture` |
